==Usage instructions==
<code><nowiki>{{HBCite|issue=|date=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

The Homing Beacon backup links directory can be found [https://web.archive.org/web/20050816191212/http://www.starwars.com/site/homingbeacon/ here.]

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|issue}} Enter the Homing Beacon issue number. This can be found in last part of the URL as highlighted below: <code><nowiki>http://www.starwars.com/site/homingbeacon/</nowiki><mark><u>67</u></mark>.html</code> which would be <code>67</code> in this instance. This can be entered as <code>{{Para|issue}}67</code> or just <code>67</code>.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|date}} Full date of publication, in [[Wikipedia:ISO 8601|ISO 8601]] <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code> format, for example "<code>date=2006-02-17</code>".

===Unneccesary parameters===
*{{Para|nolive}} As the original online content is no longer available, the template will automatically add "content now obsolete;" to the citation, and therefore does '''<u>NOT</u>''' require the use of "<code>|nolive=1</code>" like with other citation templates.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{HBCite|67|date=2002-08-22|archivedate=20050305030907}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{HBCite|67|date=2002-08-22|archivedate=20050305030907}}
